# SurfaceGuard 0.1.1

SurfaceGuard 0.1.1 fixes sitemap XML entities being decoded more than once. A nested escape now remains escaped after the one XML decoding pass, with regression coverage for the behavior.

All version 0.1.0 artifact scanning, policy, adapter, report, CLI, library, and GitHub Action interfaces remain compatible.

The attached package is for direct GitHub installation. This release is not published to npm or another package registry.
